LanguageData.StorageOverview_NoStorage: There are no stockpiles or storage buildings on this map.
LanguageData.StorageOverview_Hint:
Wheel: scroll rows. Shift + wheel, or wheel over the storage names: scroll columns.
Click a storage name: show it on the map to the right.
Right-click a storage name: rename, copy or paste settings.
Blue outline: where haulers take the item (the highest priority storage that accepts it; on a tie all are outlined and the nearest one is used).
Tick the box at the left of an item to mark it: storages accepting marked items move to the left.
Light blue cell: the storage currently holds the item (hover for the count).
LanguageData.StorageOverview_MarkTip: Mark: storages accepting marked items move to the left, the more they accept the further left; storages accepting none are dimmed and placed after the divider.
